channel.title: RocketGPT Blog
channel.description: Product updates and daily notes from RocketGPT.

item.title: Start with the rough idea
item.description: A useful first prompt does not need to be polished. Give Rocket 2.0 the rough idea and ask it to help find a clear starting point.

item.title: How Rocket 2.0 uses a large language model
item.description: Rocket 2.0 is a task-focused AI tool powered by a third-party large language model (LLM), which generates text from prompts.

item.title: Rocket 2.0 keeps its familiar name
item.description: We are returning the public AI tool to its Rocket 2.0 name for now. Its features and third-party AI service remain unchanged.

item.title: A brief Rocket 3.0 rebrand
item.description: The public AI tool briefly used the Rocket 3.0 name before returning to Rocket 2.0. The underlying service did not change.

item.title: A brighter, simpler RocketGPT
item.description: RocketGPT's homepage, Rocket 2.0 tools, and NALL-E now share a clean white look, with a page directory to make each experience easier to find.

item.title: NALL-E image generation, without an API key
item.description: NALL-E now sends image prompts to a public image service directly from the browser, so trying it does not require setting up an OpenAI key.

item.title: Introducing RocketGPT
item.description: RocketGPT is the company behind Rocket 2.0 and NALL-E, focused on building and bringing practical AI products to people.

item.title: A more reliable Rocket 2.0 experience
item.description: Rocket 2.0 now gives a clearer path through slow or failed responses, including a retry option that keeps your unsent message available.

item.title: A clearer identity for Rocket 2.0
item.description: Rocket 2.0 became the public name for the large-language-model-powered tools, giving the product a more consistent identity across its landing page and app.
